business_summary: Maiquer Group CO.,LTD manufactures and sells dairy products, baked good, and holiday foods in China. The company offers alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, purified water, as well as pre-packaged foods. It also provides manufacturing and sales of food, cold beverages, and dairy products; fermented milk, and festive gift boxes; agricultural products; livestock breeding and agricultural cultivation services; and festival products. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Changji, China.
